name: issue_1209_transient_blip_warm_day_self_resolves
description: Issue #1209 (fixed): warm day (classifier derives hvac_mode=off, comfort band armed, CA commanding cool at the 74F ceiling). The thermostat glitches to heat and returns to cool within the 10-minute confirm window; at expiry it must self-resolve with no override and no manual grace, because the thermostat is back on the mode CA itself commanded. Before the fix the expiry compared cool with the 'off' label and confirmed an override.
notes: Regression scenario for Issue #1209 (fixed): passes with the commanded-mode rule in override_confirm_split.decide_override_confirm_path; with the rule removed the 10:10 assertion fails (override_confirmed instead of override_self_resolved). The old 10:30 classification_applied check was dropped: it, and engine_state flag checks at 10:30, also pass when the override was confirmed (verified), so only the 10:10 outcome discriminates.
Occupant outcome: a momentary thermostat glitch is not mistaken for the occupant's own change; CA keeps managing comfort and no 1 h manual grace starts.

Derived from override_self_resolve_transient (golden), which covers the same blip on a HOT day (label cool); here the label is off, so only the commanded mode (cool) identifies the return as CA's own.
Proposal only: promotion to golden/ needs owner approval and --sign.

events.note: Warm-day classification (hvac_mode left to classifier.py, off): comfort band armed, active ceiling comfort_cool=74F. Forecast high 80 / low 66 agrees with the 68-74F readings; classifier derives windows_recommended true for 06:00-10:00.
Transient: thermostat briefly reports heat mode. Override detection fires; 10-min confirm window starts.
Thermostat returns to cool mode before 10:05 (transient glitch resolved)
Thermostat returns to cool mode at 10:05 — only 5 minutes elapsed, before confirm window expires. Override self-resolves.
30-min classification cycle on the same warm day (label off, band armed); no assertion rides on it.

assertions.reason: Initial warm-day classification applied: comfort band armed, CA commands cool at the comfort_cool=74F ceiling (the classifier label is hvac_mode=off).
Thermostat changed to heat while CA is commanding cool (warm-day classification: hvac_mode off, comfort band armed, cool commanded at the 74F ceiling) — pending override detection.
assertions.note: Override detection fires in coordinator _async_thermostat_changed listener.

assertions.reason: Confirm timer (override_confirm_seconds=600) fires at 10:10 — 10 minutes after detection at 10:00. Reads current thermostat state (still 'cool', set at 10:04:59) which matches the mode CA is commanding on this warm day (classifier label is hvac_mode off, band armed, cool commanded at the ceiling) — expected self-resolve path (PATH B in _confirm_override_expired), no override accepted. Corrected from 10:05 — see notes.
assertions.note: Self-resolve genuinely happens at real timer expiry, not proactively on return-to-expected.

verdict.summary: Issue #1209: a transient thermostat blip that returns to the mode CA commanded self-resolves on a warm day
verdict.observed_behavior: override_detected (10:00) -> override_self_resolved (10:10); no override, no grace at 10:30
verdict.expected_behavior: override_self_resolved at 10:10: a change that has returned to the mode Climate Advisor commanded is not an occupant override
